description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating Stability AI's image generation API into a system compatible with OpenAI's API interface. It includes methods for parameter mapping, environment validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing, specifically tailored for the Stability AI API.

classes.name: StabilityImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for managing Stability AI's image generation API interactions, supporting parameter mapping, URL handling, environment validation, request/response transformations, and indicating the need for multipart form data.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-style parameters supported for Stability AI image generation.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI API parameters into Stability AI-specific parameters, handling special translations such as 'size' to 'aspect_ratio', and managing unsupported parameters based on 'drop_params'.

methods.name: str _get_model_endpoint(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines the API endpoint URL for a given model name, with support for models prefixed with 'stability/'.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API request URL based on base URL, model, and optional parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Checks for necessary environment variables (like API key), sets authorization headers, and prepares environment for making API requests.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms an OpenAI-style request into a format suitable for Stability AI, including optional parameter inclusion.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_generation_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ImageResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Parses and converts Stability AI's image response into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse object, handling errors and filtering details.

methods.name: bool use_multipart_form_data(self)
methods.description: Indicates that Stability AI requires multipart/form-data for image generation requests.
